newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets reverses at 2.75 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets reverses at 2.75 percent.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Tuesday set reverse repurchase agreements at 2.75 percent in the Canadian money market, dealers said.
The central bank intervened after the call loan or overnight lending rate dropped to the bottom the bank's 2.75-3.25 percent target range for the rate.

"It was offered at three-quarters. It just seemed like there was more money out there than what was needed. It's just coming in there to sap it up, nothing other than that, no policy change or anything," said a dealer at one bank-owned brokerage.
The dealer said the overnight rate is now likely to drift higher and another round of reverses is unlikely. The overnight was trading at 3.0 percent at the beginning of the session.
